editorial.blurb: This beloved Rogers Park spot serves up vibrant Asian fusion with generous portions and a warm, genuine hospitality that keeps regulars coming back multiple times a month.
editorial.insiderTip: Dine in to experience the adorable ambiance and attentive service (they greet BYOB guests with glasses and a bottle cooler immediately), and arrive early—the heavy seafood aroma is noticeable but worth it for the quality.
